description: Checks the remaining Hash Credits, active Watch slots, and lifetime usage of the configured Rel-Time API key (`GET /api/v1/account`). If no API key is configured yet, returns Agent Sentinel (`sentinel` $39/mo · 10 Watches + 250 Hashes), Sovereign Command (`enterprise` $399/mo · 64 Watches + 5,000 Priority Hashes), and Zero-Rotation Top-Up options (`lightning`, `usdc`, or `stripe`) so you can ask the user in chat.

api_key.description: Optional: pass an `rk_live_...` / `rel_key_...` API key to check its balance AND automatically save it to ~/.reltime/api_key.json for all future calls.

name: reltime_account_status
